title: Automatic Seizure Detection Based on Stockwell Transform and Transformer.
summary: The S-transform plus Transformer method performs a specific retrospective seizure-detection evaluation on the CHB-MIT EEG database. The source reports segment-level and event-level metrics, including 96.15% accuracy, 96.57% event sensitivity, 0.38 false detections/hour and 20.62 s latency. Event testing uses different seizures from the same patients, so this supports patient-specific database performance, not generalization to unseen patients or clinical benefit.
